name: Terran Concord
description: Combined-arms engineers. Configurable units and towers, forward posts that repair and accept resources, staging bonuses near owned territory.

name: The Lattice
description: Slow to build, hard to kill. Units linked to two allies or a network structure take less damage and hit harder. EMP and jamming break the link.

name: The Verdant Brood
description: Fast-growing organisms that regenerate and move faster inside their Bloom territory. Adaptations force sharp tradeoffs.
